---
title: "01a Prepare Built Up Area groups"
output: html_notebook
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Builds the urban regions: groups ONS Built Up Areas (BUAs) that lie close
together, closes small gaps with an area-scaled buffer, fills enclosed
holes and splits the result into individual regions. Results are saved to
`urban_region_checkpoints/`, which `01b_Analyse_Urban_Regions.Rmd` reads.
Re-run this notebook only if the input data or a parameter changes.

```{r setup}
source(here::here("scripts", "00_setup.R"))
```

# Prepare BUA data (filter to England, join population)

```{r prepare_bua_data}
# Filter to England using the LSOA-to-Region lookup rather than the
# census population table. LSOAs cover the whole country without gaps,
# whereas the census table's BUA22 codes do not match for central London,
# so a semi_join against it would drop inner London from `bua`.
england_buas <- lsoa_lookup |>
  filter(startsWith(RGN22CD, "E12")) |>
  distinct(BUA22CD)

bua <- bua |>
  semi_join(england_buas, by = "BUA22CD")

# Add population counts and names. A left_join keeps any BUA missing from
# the census population table, with population = NA.
bua <- bua |>
  left_join(
    census |>
      select(
        BUA22CD = `BUA code`,
        population = Counts,
        size_classification = `BUA size classification`
      ),
    by = "BUA22CD"
  )
```

# Derive urban regions (buffer, group, close, fill holes, split)

Runs the whole build in the steps below: it checks the input geometry, links BUAs that lie close together, closes small gaps with a buffer scaled to each group's area, fills enclosed holes and splits the result into regions. Each step saves its result to `checkpoint_dir`, and the group-closing step resumes from the groups already saved.

```{r derive_urban_regions}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(igraph)
library(parallel)

# Settings

# coefficient and checkpoint_dir are defined in 00_setup.R.

dir.create(
  checkpoint_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# Use all but one core for the parallel group-closing step.
# mclapply() errors if mc.cores > 1 on Windows (it does NOT fall back
# to serial automatically), so cap at 1 core there.
n_cores <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  1
} else {
  max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
}

# Optional simplification tolerance (metres) applied to the input BUAs
# before buffering, to reduce vertex density on detailed boundaries.
# NULL skips simplification.
simplify_tolerance <- NULL

# Fix geometry column name

# The source data stores geometry in a column called "SHAPE" rather
# than the sf default "geometry". Rename it once here so every
# downstream call (st_buffer(geometry, ...), st_union(geometry),
# etc.) works without further changes.
if ("SHAPE" %in% names(bua) && !("geometry" %in% names(bua))) {

  names(bua)[names(bua) == "SHAPE"] <- "geometry"
  st_geometry(bua) <- "geometry"

  cat("Renamed geometry column: SHAPE -> geometry\n")
}

# Check the input
stopifnot(
  inherits(bua, "sf"),
  nrow(bua) > 0,
  st_crs(bua)$epsg == 27700
)

cat("Input BUAs:", nrow(bua), "\n")
cat("CRS: EPSG", st_crs(bua)$epsg, "\n")
cat("Cores available for parallel step:", n_cores, "\n")

# Helper functions

report_object <- function(x, label) {

  cat("\n", label, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Features:", nrow(x), "\n")

  cat(
    "Object size:",
    round(as.numeric(object.size(x)) / 1024^2, 1),
    "MB\n"
  )
}

fill_polygon_holes <- function(x) {

  input_crs <- st_crs(x)

  x <- st_make_valid(x)

  filled <- lapply(st_geometry(x), function(g) {

    polygon_parts <- st_cast(
      st_sfc(g, crs = input_crs),
      "POLYGON",
      warn = FALSE
    )

    exterior_only <- lapply(
      polygon_parts,
      function(p) st_polygon(list(p[[1]]))
    )

    # The parts came from casting a single valid feature, so they
    # are already disjoint by construction. st_combine() just
    # aggregates them into one geometry without running a GEOS
    # dissolve, which is what st_union() would do unnecessarily.
    st_combine(
      st_sfc(
        exterior_only,
        crs = input_crs
      )
    )[[1]]
  })

  st_set_geometry(
    x,
    st_sfc(
      filled,
      crs = input_crs
    )
  )
}

# Start overall timer

overall_start <- Sys.time()

cat("\nOverall start time:", format(overall_start), "\n")

# Step 0: input diagnostics (vertex density)

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("STEP 0 — Input geometry diagnostics\n")
cat("============================================\n")

step0_start <- Sys.time()

t0 <- system.time({

  vertex_counts <- sapply(
    st_geometry(bua),
    function(g) sum(lengths(g)) / 2
  )

})

step0_end <- Sys.time()

print(t0)

cat("Started:", format(step0_start), "\n")
cat("Finished:", format(step0_end), "\n")

cat("\nVertex count per BUA:\n")
print(summary(vertex_counts))

cat("\nTop 10 most detailed BUAs:\n")
print(sort(vertex_counts, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])

vertex_diagnostics <- list(
  vertex_counts = vertex_counts,
  summary = summary(vertex_counts)
)

saveRDS(
  vertex_diagnostics,
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    "00_vertex_diagnostics.rds"
  )
)

rm(vertex_counts, vertex_diagnostics)

if (!is.null(simplify_tolerance)) {

  cat(
    "\nSimplifying input geometries with dTolerance =",
    simplify_tolerance,
    "m\n"
  )

  bua <- st_simplify(
    bua,
    dTolerance = simplify_tolerance,
    preserveTopology = TRUE
  )

  bua <- st_make_valid(bua)

  cat("Simplification complete.\n")

} else {

  cat("\nsimplify_tolerance is NULL — skipping simplification.\n")
}

# Step 1: fixed link-buffer distance (for grouping only)

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("STEP 1 — Fixed link-buffer distance for grouping\n")
cat("============================================\n")

step1_start <- Sys.time()

t1 <- system.time({

  # This distance decides only whether two BUAs count as the same urban
  # area (Steps 2-3); it does not scale with area. ONS's BUA22
  # methodology treats built-up areas 200 m or less apart as one
  # settlement, so buffering each BUA outwards by half that distance and
  # testing for overlap reproduces the same 200 m rule. The closing
  # distance for each group is calculated separately in Step 4 as
  # coefficient * sqrt(group area).
  link_buffer_m <- 100

})

step1_end <- Sys.time()

print(t1)

cat("Started:", format(step1_start), "\n")
cat("Finished:", format(step1_end), "\n")

cat(
  "Link-buffer distance (grouping only):",
  link_buffer_m,
  "m\n"
)

closing_parameters <- list(
  coefficient = coefficient,
  link_buffer_m = link_buffer_m
)

saveRDS(
  closing_parameters,
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    "01_closing_parameters.rds"
  )
)

# Step 2: buffer each BUA outwards (for grouping only)

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("STEP 2 — Buffer individual BUAs outwards (for grouping)\n")
cat("============================================\n")

step2_start <- Sys.time()

t2 <- system.time({

  # Buffered only to detect which BUAs are close enough to count as one
  # urban area. These buffers feed the grouping in Step 3 only; Step 4
  # re-buffers each group's original, unbuffered geometry by its own
  # closing distance.
  bua_buffered <- bua |>
    transmute(
      bua_row_id = row_number(),
      geometry = st_buffer(
        geometry,
        dist = link_buffer_m
      )
    )

})

step2_end <- Sys.time()

print(t2)

cat("Started:", format(step2_start), "\n")
cat("Finished:", format(step2_end), "\n")

saveRDS(
  bua_buffered,
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    "02_bua_buffered.rds"
  )
)

report_object(
  bua_buffered,
  "Buffered BUA object"
)

cat("Checkpoint saved.\n")

# Step 3: identify connected buffer groups

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("STEP 3 — Identify connected buffer groups\n")
cat("============================================\n")

step3_start <- Sys.time()

t3 <- system.time({

  buffer_neighbours <- st_intersects(
    bua_buffered,
    sparse = TRUE
  )

  buffer_graph <- graph_from_adj_list(
    buffer_neighbours,
    mode = "all"
  )

  bua_buffered$closing_group <- components(
    buffer_graph
  )$membership

})

step3_end <- Sys.time()

print(t3)

cat("Started:", format(step3_start), "\n")
cat("Finished:", format(step3_end), "\n")

group_sizes <- table(bua_buffered$closing_group)

cat(
  "Connected groups:",
  n_distinct(bua_buffered$closing_group),
  "\n"
)

cat("\nGroup size distribution:\n")
print(summary(as.integer(group_sizes)))

cat("\nTop 10 largest groups (by BUA count):\n")
print(sort(group_sizes, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])

saveRDS(
  group_sizes,
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    "03b_group_size_diagnostics.rds"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  bua_buffered,
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    "03_bua_buffered_grouped.rds"
  )
)

rm(
  buffer_neighbours,
  buffer_graph,
  group_sizes
)

gc()

report_object(
  bua_buffered,
  "Grouped buffered BUAs"
)

cat("Checkpoint saved.\n")

# Step 3b: attach groups to original (unbuffered) geometry

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("STEP 3B — Attach groups to original geometry\n")
cat("============================================\n")

# Step 4 closes each group from its original geometry using its own
# area-scaled buffer distance, not the link-buffered version used only
# for grouping above.
bua_grouped <- bua |>
  transmute(
    bua_row_id = row_number(),
    closing_group = bua_buffered$closing_group,
    geometry = geometry
  )

saveRDS(
  bua_grouped,
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    "03c_bua_grouped_raw.rds"
  )
)

cat("Checkpoint saved.\n")

# Step 4: process each group separately (in parallel)

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("STEP 4 — Close each connected group\n")
cat("============================================\n")

group_ids <- sort(
  unique(bua_grouped$closing_group)
)

group_output_dir <- file.path(
  checkpoint_dir,
  "closed_groups"
)

dir.create(
  group_output_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Split row indices by group once, rather than re-filtering the full
# bua_grouped object in every iteration, so lookup by group id is fast.
group_row_indices <- split(
  seq_len(nrow(bua_grouped)),
  bua_grouped$closing_group
)

process_one_group <- function(group_id) {

  output_file <- file.path(
    group_output_dir,
    paste0(
      "closed_group_",
      sprintf("%05d", group_id),
      ".rds"
    )
  )

  # Skip groups already completed (resumable across runs)
  if (file.exists(output_file)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  idx <- group_row_indices[[as.character(group_id)]]

  group_raw <- bua_grouped[idx, ]

  # Merge this group's original (unbuffered) BUAs, then compute a closing
  # distance scaled to this group's own area (coefficient * sqrt(area)).
  group_original <- st_union(st_geometry(group_raw))

  group_area_m2 <- as.numeric(st_area(group_original))

  group_buffer_m <- coefficient * sqrt(group_area_m2)

  group_closed_geom <-
    group_original |>
    st_buffer(group_buffer_m) |>
    st_union() |>
    st_buffer(-group_buffer_m)

  group_closed <- st_sf(
    closing_group = group_id,
    bua_count = nrow(group_raw),
    buffer_m = group_buffer_m,
    geometry = group_closed_geom
  ) |>
    st_make_valid()

  group_closed <- group_closed[
    !st_is_empty(group_closed),
  ]

  saveRDS(
    group_closed,
    output_file
  )

  invisible(NULL)
}

step4_start <- Sys.time()

t4 <- system.time({

  # mclapply forks the process on Unix and Mac, so bua_buffered and
  # group_row_indices are shared copy-on-write rather than duplicated per
  # worker. On Windows it runs serially.
  invisible(
    parallel::mclapply(
      group_ids,
      process_one_group,
      mc.cores = n_cores
    )
  )

})

step4_end <- Sys.time()

print(t4)

cat("Started:", format(step4_start), "\n")
cat("Finished:", format(step4_end), "\n")

completed <- sum(
  file.exists(
    file.path(
      group_output_dir,
      paste0(
        "closed_group_",
        sprintf("%05d", group_ids),
        ".rds"
      )
    )
  )
)

cat(
  "Groups completed:",
  completed,
  "/",
  length(group_ids),
  "\n"
)

rm(bua_buffered, bua_grouped, group_row_indices)
gc()

# Step 5: combine completed groups

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("STEP 5 — Combine closed groups\n")
cat("============================================\n")

step5_start <- Sys.time()

t5 <- system.time({

  group_files <- list.files(
    group_output_dir,
    pattern = "\\.rds$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  closed_group_list <- lapply(
    group_files,
    readRDS
  )

  urban_closed <- do.call(
    rbind,
    closed_group_list
  )

  urban_closed <- st_make_valid(
    urban_closed
  )

  urban_closed <- urban_closed[
    !st_is_empty(urban_closed),
  ]

})

step5_end <- Sys.time()

print(t5)

cat("Started:", format(step5_start), "\n")
cat("Finished:", format(step5_end), "\n")

saveRDS(
  urban_closed,
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    "05_urban_closed.rds"
  )
)

rm(
  closed_group_list
)

gc()

report_object(
  urban_closed,
  "Combined closed urban geometry"
)

cat("Checkpoint saved.\n")

# Step 6: fill enclosed holes

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("STEP 6 — Fill enclosed holes\n")
cat("============================================\n")

step6_start <- Sys.time()

t6 <- system.time({

  urban_filled <- fill_polygon_holes(
    urban_closed
  )

  urban_filled <- st_make_valid(
    urban_filled
  )

})

step6_end <- Sys.time()

print(t6)

cat("Started:", format(step6_start), "\n")
cat("Finished:", format(step6_end), "\n")

saveRDS(
  urban_filled,
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    "06_urban_holes_filled.rds"
  )
)

report_object(
  urban_filled,
  "Hole-filled urban geometry"
)

cat("Checkpoint saved.\n")

# Step 7: split into individual urban regions

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("STEP 7 — Create final urban-region polygons\n")
cat("============================================\n")

step7_start <- Sys.time()

t7 <- system.time({

  # Cast row by row. Casting the whole urban_filled object at once can
  # silently drop parts of very large multipart groups (London, for
  # example, came out as a small fragment). Expanding each row
  # independently keeps every part.
  urban_regions_list <- lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(urban_filled)),
    function(i) {
      st_cast(
        urban_filled[i, ],
        "POLYGON",
        warn = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

  urban_regions <- do.call(rbind, urban_regions_list)

  urban_regions <- st_make_valid(urban_regions)

  urban_regions <- urban_regions[
    !st_is_empty(urban_regions),
  ]

  # Compute area once and reuse it for the sort key and for area_ha.
  area_m2 <- as.numeric(st_area(urban_regions$geometry))

  urban_regions <- urban_regions |>
    mutate(area_m2 = area_m2) |>
    arrange(desc(area_m2)) |>
    mutate(
      urban_region_id = row_number(),
      area_ha = area_m2 / 10000
    ) |>
    select(
      urban_region_id,
      closing_group,
      bua_count,
      area_ha,
      geometry
    )

})

step7_end <- Sys.time()

print(t7)

cat("Started:", format(step7_start), "\n")
cat("Finished:", format(step7_end), "\n")

saveRDS(
  urban_regions,
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    "07_urban_regions_final.rds"
  )
)

st_write(
  urban_regions,
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    "urban_regions_final.gpkg"
  ),
  layer = "urban_regions",
  delete_layer = TRUE,
  quiet = TRUE
)

report_object(
  urban_regions,
  "Final urban regions"
)

# Timing summary

overall_end <- Sys.time()

timings <- rbind(
  input_diagnostics = t0,
  closing_distance = t1,
  outward_buffer = t2,
  connected_groups = t3,
  group_closing = t4,
  combine_groups = t5,
  hole_filling = t6,
  final_regions = t7
)

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("COMPLETE\n")
cat("============================================\n")

cat("Overall start:", format(overall_start), "\n")
cat("Overall finish:", format(overall_end), "\n")

cat(
  "Overall elapsed time:",
  round(
    as.numeric(
      difftime(
        overall_end,
        overall_start,
        units = "mins"
      )
    ),
    2
  ),
  "minutes\n"
)

cat(
  "Final urban regions:",
  nrow(urban_regions),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Total final area:",
  round(sum(urban_regions$area_ha), 1),
  "ha\n"
)

cat("\nIndividual timings:\n")
print(timings)

saveRDS(
  timings,
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    "08_processing_timings.rds"
  )
)

# Quick visual check

plot(
  st_geometry(urban_regions),
  col = "grey70",
  border = "black",
  main = paste(
    nrow(urban_regions),
    "derived urban regions"
  )
)

```

# Plot London to check the build.

Checks the intermediate objects from Steps 5 and 6 (`urban_closed`,
`urban_filled`) straight after a build, before Step 7 splits them into
final regions. Run it immediately after the build chunk above; it cannot
be run on its own.

```{r london_diagnostic_plot}
london_bbox <- st_bbox(
  c(xmin = 500000, ymin = 145000, xmax = 570000, ymax = 210000),
  crs = st_crs(urban_regions)
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))

plot(st_geometry(st_crop(bua, london_bbox)), col = "grey70", border = "black", main = "Raw BUAs (this run)")
plot(st_geometry(st_crop(urban_closed, london_bbox)), col = "grey70", border = "black", main = "After closing (Step 5)")
plot(st_geometry(st_crop(urban_filled, london_bbox)), col = "grey70", border = "black", main = "After hole-fill (Step 6)")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
